q: Separation convention of 1924 on railways is the result of recommendations of which Committee?
e: The Separation Convention of 1924, which separated railway finances from general finances, resulted from the recommendations of the Acworth Committee. It introduced the convention of the railways paying a dividend to the general exchequer on capital-at-charge, and ended when the Railway Budget merged with the General Budget in 2017-18.
